quests.question: Thin, pale and weak from months of too little food, the child was _____.
quests.explanation: Thin, pale and weak from too little food shows poor nutrition, so malnourished fits.

quests.question: Her back pain has lasted ten years and never fully goes away; it is a _____ condition.
quests.explanation: Pain lasting ten years that never fully goes away is long-term, so chronic fits.

quests.question: Burning with fever, he raved about ships in the bedroom and didn't know his own name; he was _____.
quests.explanation: Raving about ships and forgetting his name during fever show confused, wild thinking: delirious.

quests.question: The flu spread to every desk in the office within days; it was highly _____.
quests.explanation: Spreading to every desk within days shows it passes easily between people: contagious.

quests.question: Taking a pill before travel to stop malaria from ever starting is a _____ measure.
quests.explanation: Taking a pill before travel to stop disease starting is preventive, which is prophylactic.

quests.question: The flu left her body hurting from head to toe and every joint sore; she felt _____.
quests.explanation: Hurting from head to toe with sore joints is what achy means; pain-free contradicts.

quests.question: Every spring, his eyes itched and he sneezed near flowers; he is _____ to pollen.
quests.explanation: Itchy eyes and sneezing near flowers show his body reacts badly to pollen, so allergic fits.

quests.question: Tests found no infection, injury or genetic cause; the illness seemed _____, arising for no known reason.
quests.explanation: No infection, injury or genetic cause means the illness has no known origin: idiopathic.

quests.question: Most cases could have been avoided with a simple vaccine or handwashing; the illness was _____.
quests.explanation: Cases avoidable with a vaccine or handwashing could have been stopped: preventable.

quests.question: After three days in bed, he could barely lift the glass; he felt _____.
quests.explanation: Barely being able to lift a glass shows lack of strength, so weak fits; powerful contradicts.

quests.question: With no cure possible, care aimed only at easing pain and comforting the final weeks; it was _____.
quests.explanation: Easing pain without curing the disease is what palliative care means; curative contradicts.

quests.question: He tested positive but had no cough, fever or aches; he was _____.
quests.explanation: Testing positive but having no cough, fever or aches means no symptoms: asymptomatic.

quests.question: Hollow eyes, grey skin and a skull-like face gave him a _____ look.
quests.explanation: Hollow eyes, grey skin and a skull-like face give a corpse-like appearance: cadaverous.

quests.question: He had all his shots and was protected against measles; he was fully _____.
quests.explanation: Having all his shots and protection against measles means he was immunised: vaccinated.

quests.question: Weeks after the operation, she rested at home and slowly regained strength; she was _____.
quests.explanation: Resting at home and slowly regaining strength after surgery is recovering: convalescent.

quests.question: The disease killed within days and spread through the village overnight; it was a _____ strain.
quests.explanation: Killing within days and spreading overnight shows an extremely harmful strain: virulent.

quests.question: The migraines left her unable to work, drive or even read for days; they were _____.
quests.explanation: Being unable to work, drive or read for days shows severe weakening, so debilitating fits.

quests.question: She runs 10 km every morning and swims twice a week; she is very _____.
quests.explanation: Running 10 km daily and swimming twice a week keep the body in good shape, so fit fits.

quests.question: After sleeping in a chair, his neck wouldn't turn and his back ached; he felt _____.
quests.explanation: A neck that won't turn and an aching back show reduced movement: stiff; limber contradicts.

quests.question: After the stroke, he couldn't leave his bed and needed help every day; he was _____.
quests.explanation: Being unable to leave his bed and needing daily help means confined to bed: bedridden.

quests.question: After shouting at the match all night, his voice was rough and cracked; he was _____.
quests.explanation: A rough, cracked voice after a night of shouting is hoarse; silky and clear contradict.

quests.question: After the accident, she lay unresponsive and could not be woken by sound or touch; she was _____.
quests.explanation: Being unresponsive to sound and touch and impossible to wake means deep unconsciousness: comatose.

quests.question: The pain struck suddenly and fiercely, and he was rushed in within an hour; it was _____.
quests.explanation: Sudden, fierce pain needing urgent care is what acute means; mild and dull contradict.

quests.question: Starved for months, his ribs and cheekbones jutted out sharply; he looked _____.
quests.explanation: Months of starvation and jutting ribs and cheekbones show extreme thinness: emaciated.

quests.question: Her forehead was burning and she shivered under three blankets; she felt _____.
quests.explanation: A burning forehead and shivering under blankets are signs of a high temperature: feverish.

quests.question: The weightlifter hoisted 150 kg overhead without a wobble; she is incredibly _____.
quests.explanation: Lifting 150 kg overhead without a wobble shows great power, so strong fits; feeble contradicts.

quests.question: Doctors said no known treatment could cure the disease, only slow it; it was _____.
quests.explanation: 'No known treatment could cure it, only slow it' means it cannot be cured, so incurable fits; curable contradicts.

quests.question: The test needed a long needle and a small cut, unlike a simple scan; it was _____.
quests.explanation: A long needle and a cut go inside the body, unlike a simple scan, so the test was invasive, not external.

quests.question: The boat rocked and rolled, and my stomach churned; I felt _____.
quests.explanation: A rocking boat and a churning stomach point to feeling sick, so queasy fits; steady and refreshed contradict.

quests.question: With a runny nose and constant sneezing from a cold, he was _____.
quests.explanation: A runny nose and constant sneezing show a cold, so sniffly fits; healthy contradicts.
